articles.title: Morgan Stanley tops estimates as equities trading revenue beats expectations by $909 million
articles.summary: Morgan Stanley topped expectations on the top and bottom lines for the third quarter.

articles.title: Bank of America shares drop after third-quarter revenue miss and regulatory penalty
articles.summary: Bank of America shares fell Wednesday after the company posted weaker-than-expected trading revenue and the impact of a $1.2 billion Treasury fine.

articles.title: BlackRock draws $205 billion in client funds as quarterly profit beats estimates
articles.summary: BlackRock's assets under management — which determine a large chunk of its earnings — rose to $15.49 trillion, from $13.46 trillion a year earlier.

articles.title: ASML says it's getting order interest through 2030 as profit smashes expectations
articles.summary: ASML said some customers are "expressing an interest" in placing orders with the company in 2029 and 2030, giving investors a view into longer-term demand.

articles.title: We're upgrading our rating on Wells Fargo as the stock's pullback offers a nice entry point
articles.summary: Wells Fargo's third-quarter results were not perfect, but CEO Charlie Scharf's turnaround should bear more fruit ahead.
